answer: The economy spends reputation the way a market spends money: sparingly and against verified performance, so Sybil inflation is filtered out before it can compound into a decisive advantage. So the design does not rely on catching every cheat — it makes cheating unprofitable, which is a far more stable defense than any whitelist ever could be.. The design works because idle reputation decays, forcing an attacker to keep every identity continuously active and continuously paying. Consider a dune as the anchor of the cost.
